Xenvo Wireless Charger With Bluetooth Speaker – Smart Design Meets Premium Performance

The Xenvo Wireless Charger With Bluetooth Speaker is a perfect blend of modern technology, elegant aesthetics, and everyday convenience. Designed for users who value functionality and style, this innovative device combines a 10 W wireless charging pad with a powerful Bluetooth speaker, ambient lighting, and intelligent controls. Whether you’re working, relaxing, or entertaining, this all-in-one charging and audio solution enhances your space effortlessly.

Built with premium built quality, the Xenvo wireless charger ensures durability, stability, and a refined finish that complements both home and office interiors. Its thoughtfully engineered design eliminates clutter while delivering fast wireless charging and immersive sound from a single compact unit.

Fast & Reliable 10 W Wireless Charging Pad

The integrated 10 W wireless charging pad provides efficient and stable power delivery for Qi-enabled smartphones and accessories. Simply place your device on the charging surface to enjoy seamless charging without tangled cables. Advanced safety features protect against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits, ensuring your devices stay safe at all times.

The Xenvo Wireless Charger With Bluetooth Speaker is compatible with most Android and iOS devices, making it a versatile charging solution for daily use. Its optimized charging coil ensures consistent power transfer even during extended usage.

Enjoy rich, balanced audio with the built-in Bluetooth speaker that delivers crisp highs, clear vocals, and deep bass. Whether you’re listening to music, attending virtual meetings, or watching videos, the speaker offers an immersive sound experience.

With stable Bluetooth connectivity, the speaker pairs quickly with smartphones, tablets, and laptops. The Xenvo Wireless Charger With Bluetooth Speaker ensures uninterrupted audio streaming, making it ideal for both personal and professional environments.

3 Colour Mode Lighting with Adjustable Brightness

Enhance your ambience with the elegant 3 Colour mode lighting system. Switch between warm, cool, and neutral light tones to suit your mood or environment. The adjustable brightness feature allows precise control, making it perfect for nightstands, desks, or mood lighting setups. Whether you need soft illumination for relaxation or brighter light for focus, the lighting modes add both functionality and aesthetic appeal.

Flexible Neck for Maximum Convenience

The intelligently designed flexible neck allows you to adjust the angle and direction of the light with ease. This feature ensures personalized positioning for reading, working, or relaxing, without disturbing others nearby.

Combined with its sturdy base and premium built quality, the flexible neck enhances durability while offering everyday convenience.

Why Choose?

  • All-in-one design: Wireless charging, Bluetooth speaker, and ambient lighting in one unit
  • 10 W wireless charging pad: Fast, cable-free charging for Qi-enabled devices
  • High-performance Bluetooth speaker: Clear, powerful sound with stable connectivity
  • 3 Colour mode lighting: Warm, cool, and neutral tones for every mood
  • Adjustable brightness: Customize light intensity for comfort and efficiency
  • Flexible neck: Easily adjust lighting angles for personalized use
  • Premium built quality: Durable materials with a modern, elegant finish
  • Space-saving solution: Ideal for desks, bedside tables, and offices

Perfect for Home, Office & Gifting

The is designed to fit seamlessly into modern lifestyles. Its multifunctional design makes it an excellent choice for workspaces, bedrooms, and living areas. It also serves as a premium gifting option for tech enthusiasts, professionals, and students. Upgrade your daily routine with a smart, stylish, and reliable solution that delivers fast charging, immersive audio, and customizable lighting—all in one sleek device.
